home.heroDescription: A perpetual calendar for Vietnamese users: the lunar day right in the month grid, can-chi, solar terms, auspicious hours, domestic and international holidays, a countdown to Tết — and it all works offline.

features.title: What's inside
features.subtitle: Enough for everyday use, nothing extra.

lunar.title: Vietnamese lunar calendar
lunar.description: Computed on UTC+7, with leap months, day/month/year can-chi, and the 24 solar terms.

holidays.title: Vietnamese & international holidays
holidays.description: Tết, Hùng Kings' Day, Mid-Autumn… recomputed for every year, never hard-coded.

convert.title: Two-way date conversion
convert.description: Solar ↔ lunar instantly, with leap-month support, copy or jump straight to that date.

search.title: Smart search
search.description: Type “15/08/2026”, “rằm tháng 7”, or “Tết 2027” and get a match.

share.title: Share a date as an image
share.description: Export any date as an image to send to friends in one tap.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.description: Install it like an app — the calendar and holidays stay available with no connection.
